seo.metaDescription: Contour is a web design and local marketing firm based in Travelers Rest, SC. We build for growing businesses.

blocks.opening: We build fast, modern websites and local marketing for businesses in Greenville, SC and beyond. No ticket system — we answer personally.
blocks.storyBody:
Contour is built on years of experience in web development, SEO, and small business ownership. We came together to build something simple and effective: websites that are fast, secure, and built to stay visible as search and AI continue to evolve.



Devin is a software developer with over 15 years of experience building websites across multiple platforms and frameworks, and web applications. He has worked on national development teams, including Howard Development & Consulting, and has also run his own web development business for more than a decade, helping small businesses build and improve their online presence.

He is deeply focused on modern web technology and how it intersects with search and AI. Most recently, he attended the Gartner AI Conference in Las Vegas to stay current on where search, automation, and digital discovery are heading—so the work we build today doesn’t fall behind tomorrow.

Karen brings over a decade of experience owning and operating a small business, along with certifications in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Google Business Profile optimization, and Google Analytics. She understands not just how to get a business found online, but how to turn that visibility into real customers and revenue.

Together, we’re craftspeople in our own right. We understand what it means to be hired for your skill—and to take responsibility for the outcome, not just the task. We’ve both been on the receiving end of good work and bad work, and we know the difference.

That’s what we’re building here: a firm that handles a side of your business—cleanly, reliably, and without constant oversight—so you can stay focused on the work only you can do.

[Learn more about Devin's development background. ](https://www.linkedin.com/in/degger/)

![](/uploads/IMG_2207.jpeg)
blocks.howWeWork:
We survey before we build. Every engagement starts with a real discovery conversation — we learn your business, your customers, and where you're trying to go before we touch a line of code or write a word of copy.

Then we build to that. Not a template dropped on you, not a generic five-page site with your logo swapped in — a site shaped to your situation.

After that, we get out of your way. You own your site and your domain, always. If something needs attention, you call us — not a support queue.

A good website is the kind of thing you stop thinking about. That's the goal — get it right, hand it back, move on.
